limitations: All grades are provisional browser judgments from the attached screenshots, chronological still-frame filmstrips and supplied runtime narrative; no tools, source, prior rounds or other graders were consulted.
Dimension scores are 0–10; A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces, F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility, and overall is 0.4A + 0.6F with applicable hard-gate caps.
Corresponding normal, enlarged and transition captures are grouped by named state; shared defects lower the grouped score rather than disappearing in an average.
Runtime results are supplied evidence, not independently rerun checks; screenshot appearance alone does not establish interaction, persistence or accessibility behavior.
Background-source disclaimer text visibly crosses dark cutouts in sheet 28; this is an essential-readability gate despite the supplied aggregate contrast and layout passes.
Below-viewport content and scrolled captures are not automatically failures; deductions concern visible cut-edge collisions, weak overflow cues, crowded grouping or footer-boundary presentation.
Filmstrips establish sampled visual continuity only; their elapsed times include capture overhead and do not establish frame rate.
The reported isolated browser timing and reduced-motion checks support browser scores; independent layer structure, parallax and native motion behavior cannot be established from the images.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, actual OS sharing, connected social services and native performance remain deferred without blanket score deductions.
Billing is simulated, invitation sharing is mocked, and synthetic forecast/source fixtures provide no evidence of predictive accuracy or production research quality.
The browser threshold of A >= 9 and F >= 9 for every screen and meaningful component is not met; this report does not certify native or full-product 9/10 quality.
topFixes: Fix parchment safe areas first: the Background sources disclaimer and other opening passage lines must sit entirely on solid paper at both text scales.
Coordinate room painting changes with foreground entry; the supplied destination filmstrips expose dark intermediary scenes and visibly separate background settling.
Keep enlarged Approach headings on their supporting surface and simplify tall centered forecast, context and check-in groups without reducing text enlargement.
Strengthen scroll-edge and footer-clearance cues in long inputs, invitation results and enlarged content; avoid partially sliced lines and controls.
Improve normal-size forecast dominance and group secondary actions by purpose rather than giving every centered link equal emphasis.
Refine material depth through consistent edge thickness, restrained contact shadows and better room integration of the Sky panel; additional texture alone will not resolve these issues.
